name: distractor_resistance
description: Tests whether the policy resists retrieving semantically similar but irrelevant memories.

seed_memories.core: PEP uses spreading activation to find relevant memories. Activation decays over hops.
Neural activation in the brain involves sodium and potassium ion channels.
The store uses SQLite for persistence. Memories are JSON-serialized Pydantic models.
A grocery store uses inventory management to track perishable goods.
Memory drift tracks how a memory changes across reactivation events.
Continental drift describes the movement of tectonic plates over geological time.
